site_schema.summary: The schema presents GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering and generative AI development provider, including offers the company does not sell. It also contains unsupported or conflicting service promises, timelines, founder claims, and insurance details that need correction before this schema is used.

llm_problems.fix: Replace the Applied AI Engineering positioning with the approved company description and remove the claims about turning engineering into AI-native production.
